Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was assuming the first citation reference on Carl Nebel’s Wikipedia page was the MFAH collection page without properly verifying the actual reference target from Wikipedia’s HTML. The code then searched the citation link incorrectly and ended up with `https://en.wikipedia.org#cite_note-thb-1`, which is just an internal Wikipedia anchor, not the external source page. As a result, the later image lookup fetched the MFAH logo instead of the intended image, causing the OCR failure and derailing the solution.
